sources.title: nemotron-asr-streaming Model by NVIDIA | NVIDIA NIM
sources.snippet: Nemotron 3 ASR is a 600-million-parameter streaming Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) model engineered for high-quality English transcription across both low-latency streaming and high-throughput batch workloads. Developed by NVIDIA, it natively outputs punctuation and capitalization with no post-processing required.

sources.title: Nemotron-3.5-ASR-Streaming-0.6B — 40 Locales, CoreML/MLX | Soniqo
sources.snippet: Run NVIDIA's nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-.6b on-device — CoreML INT8 and MLX 4-bit bundles, 40 locales, streaming Swift code. Mac and Android, fully local.

sources.title: Nemotron 3.5 ASR — real-time streaming speech-to-text
sources.snippet: Self-hosted, GPU-accelerated streaming speech recognition built on nvidia/nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-.6b — a multilingual (40 language-locales) cache-aware FastConformer-RNNT model. It ships as two containers: a FastAPI inference server on your GPU and a small web UI, so you can open a page on your phone or laptop and watch words appear as you speak. Clone it and run one script.

sources.title: Lorqa/nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-multilingual-0.6b-coreml · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: CoreML build of NVIDIA's Nemotron 3.5 streaming ASR model, used by Lorqa for on-device live captions and audio transcripts on macOS and iOS. Runs on the Apple Neural Engine through the FluidAudio SDK.

sources.title: framadhita/INT8-nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-0.6b · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This model is the multilingual extension of nvidia/nemotron-speech-streaming-en-.6b, adding language-ID prompt conditioning to support transcription across 40 language-locales from a single model.
